findings.title: Tagged family combat stats are not cross-validated against the encounter snapshot
findings.evidence: Each combat number is checked only against broad numeric bounds. validFamilyEncounter checks encounter shape, matching metadata, and elite rank, but not hp <= maxHp or stat derivation from definition/traits/variant/context. The architecture preflight requires both checks.
findings.impact: A forged or corrupt family encounter save can resume with impossible combat HP/stats once a family combat consumer exists.
findings.phaseDisposition: No current Phase 1 producer or consumer exists; canonical derived-stat resolver belongs to Phase 3. This is a required pre-Phase-3 follow-up rather than a current Phase 1 gate blocker.
findings.closure: Before enabling family encounters, validate hp <= maxHp and exact derived combat stats with the shared Phase 3 resolver. Until then reject any usable family encounter payload.
